name: Essayist
description:
The Academic Writing App. 

What is it?
Essayist is a specialized word processor with a built-in reference manager. Write, cite, and manage/store references all in one app.

Who is Essayist for?
Essayist was designed for anyone who writes academic papers: from high school and university/college students to researchers and professionals.

How does Essayist work?
Choose your citation style and start writing! Essayist is designed with a simple and intuitive interface and only has features relevant to academic writing.

How much does Essayist cost?
Essayist has two subscription options: $9.99/Month or $79.99/Year.

What citation styles does Essayist support?
Essayist currently APA 7, MLA 8 & 9, Turabian 9 (Chicago), and several Harvard Style variations.

Can I generate references in Essayist?
Yes! Essayist offers many options to add and generate references: Built-in Google Scholar search, built-in book & journal search, paste a URL, manual entry forms, and a custom reference form.


______________________

✱ Features ✱

Automatic Formatting
Let Essayist handle the formatting so you can focus on the content of your essay. From page set-up to citations, footnotes & references, Essayist takes care of everything.

Reference Manager
Collect, store and organize references using Essayist’s built-in reference manager. Once added, Essayist automatically generates perfectly formatted bibliographies.

Citations
Insert citations seamlessly. With the tap of a button, Essayist presents a list of all your references. Select the reference(s) you wish to cite and continue writing.

Google Scholar
Search for references in the familiar Google Scholar interface. Then, simply click Add to Essayist on any reference you find. Alternatively, use Essayist’s built-in book and journal search or simply paste a URL.

APA, MLA & More
Essayist currently supports four commonly-used citation styles: APA, Chicago/Turabian, Harvard and MLA. Stay tuned for many more citation styles!

Various Reference Types
From Journal Articles, books and websites, to legal cases, datasets and interviews, Essayist covers a wide variety of different types of references.

Figures & Equations
Easily add figures, tables or equations to your essays, while Essayist ensures the correct formatting of titles, captions and even numbering.

Extra Sections
Essayist supports extra sections such as Table of Contents, Abstract, Appendices and Chapters.

More Features
Essayist has many more features and adds new functionality in regular updates.
- Export to PDF or Word
- Import BibTeX
- Backgrounds
